description: capture of an idea touching two places with one decision in it: one task with a normal body
prompt: /f10:capture Log every request the notes server handles: method, path, status and duration, one line per request to stderr. Wrap the handler routes() returns, in main.go, so every route is logged. A -quiet flag turns the log off. GET /health is left out, because the load balancer probes it every few seconds and would flood the log.

lines: The body states the problem the task solves, not only the change to make
The body says what is in scope: the fields logged, where the log goes and the -quiet flag
The body says GET /health is left out of the log, and why
The body has an Areas note naming the parts of the codebase the task touches
The body holds no code snippet and no effort estimate
